caption:
Koko leaves a great appointment, then forgets the reps by the time she gets home. Can she bring someone along?

Absolutely. Partners, friends, family members and carers are welcome. A second set of ears can help you remember the plan and ask the questions you forgot. If English isn't your first language, someone close to you can help explain things. Just let us know when you book.

Agree on their role on the way in, and ask if they can film the exercise demo on your phone. You can always ask to speak with your practitioner on your own.

Our team at Hybrid Physio is happy to include your support person. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
